main_text.p: [D]icuntur autem ancipites: quòd in quibusdam dictionibus producantur; in quibusdam corripiantur; in quibusdam denique, modò producta, modò correpta inveniantur.]
main_text.head: II. Vocalium aliæ sunt mutabiles, aliæ immutabiles.
main_text.p: II.Mutabiles, quæ formandis temporibus Verborum in alias commutari solent, ut, α & ε in η: o in ω.
Immutabiles, quæ sic in alias mutari non solent, ut, η, ι, υ, & ω.
main_text.head: III. Vocalium aliæ sunt præpositivæ, aliæ postpositivæ.
main_text.p: III.Præpositivæ, quæ in diphthongis præponuntur, ut: α, ε, η, ο, & ω.
Postpositivæ, quæ in diphthongis postponuntur, ut: ι, & υ. [Quanquam υ in unica diphthongo etiam præponitur, sequente ι.]
I.Diphthongi sunt duodecim: sex propriæ, & sex impropriæ.
Propriæ, quarum mistus sonus in pronuntiando exauditur, ut: αυ, ευ, ευ, ου, οι, υι.
Impropriæ, quarum mistus sonus in pronuntiando non exauditur, ut: α, η, ω, η, ηυ, ωυ.

page.notes: Marginal stains obscure the left-margin notes; the Greek diphthong forms and some diacritics are doubtful and approximated. Left-margin note letters are partly illegible.
